answer: An admission auction stops fake identities. Each epoch, 200 slots are auctioned: agents bid sealed, pay the clearing price, and lock the stake 20 epochs. A glacier builds slowly, and so does a bidder's record; it cannot be faked overnight like a comet crossing a lagoon. Forging 100 identities means winning 100 slots at 50 POA each: 5,000 POA locked 20 epochs. An honest agent pays one bid and recovers it in 6 epochs; cheaters forfeit the stake.
